articles.title: Brandon McNulty Wins Cycling World Title in Montreal — First American Since 1993
articles.summary: Brandon McNulty shocked everyone by winning the men's elite road race at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal. He rode alone for the last 33 kilometres and finished in 6 hours, 17 minutes, 4 seconds.

articles.title: Teen Invents Plant-Based Plastic That Eats Microplastics
articles.summary: Arya Satheesh, 18, from Ireland, created Eco Purge — a plant-based plastic that breaks down microplastics in the environment. She won $12,500 at The Earth Prize for her invention.

articles.title: AI in Space: Helpful Assistant or Sci-Fi Villain?
articles.summary: NASA and other space agencies use AI to guide Mars rovers and prevent satellite crashes. But today's AI makes mistakes, so humans still need to stay in control.
